A new **Fighter** starts with: **Longsword, Shield, Potion of Healing, and Torches** (item IDs 2, 15, 17, 23).

Defined in `worker/src/services/character.ts:65`, in the `CLASS_STARTING_ITEMS` map (keyed by class, listing item IDs). The actual item names/IDs come from the seed data in `worker/src/db/seed.sql` (rows inserted in order). Note: per the docs, ID 23 is actually "Torches" even though code comments mislabel it as "Rations" (tracked as bug B-09).
